cards.title: Why it works
items: Drafting is cheap and fast, publishing is gated and strong: seat tiering maps to consequence, not to stage order
The judge's answer is routed by grammar — complementary when-gates make rewrite and publish mutually exclusive
Nothing publishes from agent discretion; the gate's committed value is the only key

items: {{gates}} human gate, {{branches}} branch gates, {{agents}} agents: draft -> approve -> publish | rewrite
